S50U26.today_summary: 1072.8 anchor closed 5.1 lower and 12.4 below the 08-17 high of 1085.2, fully round-tripping the breakout above the 1080 call wall (2,313 OI). The session's real flow was 599 lots into the 910 put, lifting its OI to 14,916 (+2,597 over two sessions) at 24.6% strike IV - deep tail insurance bought while near-money put OI at 1070-1090 fell. Cumulative net GEX at spot is -5,856 with the gamma flip 37.2 points above at 1110, so dealers sit short gamma into any move under 1070. Treat the 1070 max-pain print with caution: total intrinsic value rises monotonically from 1020 to 1120, so this chain has no near-money pain minimum to be pulled toward.
what_changed: 910 put OI jumped +2,597 to 14,916 over two sessions (+40% since 08-07) on 599 lots today at 24.6% strike IV - a live tail hedge, not stale structural OI.
Spot round-tripped the 08-17 breakout: 1085.2 to 1072.8, -12.4 over two sessions (-5.1 today), back under the 1080 call wall.
25-delta skew flipped to +1.40 put-rich from +0.12 on 08-17, and P/C OI ratio hit a window-high 2.04 from 1.84 as put OI grew +3,141 against call OI -233.
ATM gamma shelf collapsed 78% to +1,390 from +6,177 and the gamma flip drifted up to 1110 from 1100, as 1110-1140 call OI was unwound (-257 combined).
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has printed 1070 for all 8 sessions from 08-07 through 08-19 while spot travelled 1079.5 to 1071.7 to 1085.2 and back to 1072.8, so the anchor has carried no information - the real migration is at 910, where put OI ran 10,655 to 14,916 (+40%) with volume spikes on 08-13 (563), 08-17 (1,015) and 08-19 (599). Call OI has been inert across the same window (17,173 on 08-13 to 17,304 today, +0.8%) while put OI added +4,918 (+16%), pushing P/C OI from 1.77 to 2.04. ATM IV has chopped in a tight 12.50-13.62 band and closed at 12.99% today, so this build was accumulated at cheap vol rather than in a panic. The 08-17 session was the tell: a 13.6-point thrust cleared the 1080 call wall on call-rich skew of +0.12, and both the price and the skew fully reversed within two sessions. The structure now reads as a market financing cheap deep-downside insurance while the near-money gamma shelf that capped the 1077-1085 range drains away.

strategies.name: 1060/1030 put debit spread
strategies.rationale: Every strike from 1060 down carries negative net GEX (-205 at 1060, -1,427 at 1050, -965 at 1040, -874 at 1030), so a slide below spot is met by dealers selling into it; 13.0% ATM IV makes that convexity cheap to own.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, capped by the 30-point spread width.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1080 call wall, which restores the +2,337 positive-gamma shelf.

strategies.name: 1090/1110 call credit spread
strategies.rationale: The 1080-1110 band is the only positive-gamma shelf in the chain (+2,337 at 1080, +690 at 1090, +1,792 at 1100), so dealer hedging dampens rallies through it, and the 1110 flip is where that support ends.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width minus net credit received.
strategies.invalidation: A close above the 1110 gamma flip, which turns dealers long gamma above spot and removes the ceiling logic.

strategies.name: 1040/1010 put debit spread
strategies.rationale: Sits in the OI air pocket under the 1050 near-put wall (1,702 OI, 271 live lots) and lands on the 1020 10-delta band, expressing the same tail demand that put 599 lots into the 910 put at a 11.6-point IV premium to ATM.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, capped by the 30-point spread width.
strategies.invalidation: A hold above 1050 on falling put volume, which would mark the tail bid as hedging rather than positioning.

S50U26.prediction: Bias is drift within 1050-1080 with downside acceleration risk rather than a clean trend: a break of the 1050 near-put wall (1,702 OI, 271 live lots) enters an air pocket where net GEX runs -965 to -1,427 per strike and dealer hedging amplifies the move. The 8.78-point 1-sigma daily move puts 1050 roughly 2.6 sigma away, so this is a multi-session setup, not a one-day call. A close back above 1080 reclaims the positive-gamma shelf and invalidates the bearish read.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and pinning toward max pain is structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks - treat 1070 as a tendency at most. In this chain it is weaker still: total intrinsic value rises monotonically from 1020 to 1120, so the 1070 print is a feed convention rather than a demonstrated near-money pain minimum, and the full-chain minimum sits near 950 under the weight of the 14,916-lot 910 put block. Defined-risk structures still carry a real max loss, and the 08-18 session is missing from the feed, so the one-day deltas above span two sessions.
